description: Ends your own unsubmitted get_review_task lease now, without a verdict, so the mod goes back in the pool. When you stop early (the user says stop, an error, a limit), release every task you haven't submitted, then delete its folder. Only your own tasks; calling it again is a no-op, and released: false means it was already submitted. A released task can't be submitted.

taskId.description: Your own task from get_review_task that you won't submit.

name: release_review_task
title: Give back a task you won't submit
